snippet.title: Reclaimer Launch Trailer | Halo Infinite
snippet.description:
Operation: Reclaimer has come. You can test your might in S&D Extraction, brave new Action Sack modes, and immortalize your triumphs with a library of armor sets honoring Halo 4. 

Complete the free 20-tier Operation Pass to unlock the mysterious Venator armor set. Upgrade to the Premium Operation Pass to add the Promethean Bandit weapon model and Serpentine Gradient weapon coatings to your armory.

You’ll have until August 5 to cement your legacy.
